nodes.description: Constant bytes32 storage slot holding the proxy admin address (EIP-1967 style admin slot).
Constant bytes32 storage slot holding the address of the currently active logic (implementation) contract.
Constant bytes32 storage slot holding the proposed next logic contract address awaiting its delay block.
Constant bytes32 storage slot holding the block number from which the proposed logic may be activated.
Constant bytes32 storage slot holding the block number before which new logic proposals are not allowed.
Constant bytes32 storage slot holding the boolean flag that switches the proxy from instant-upgrade mode to trust-minimized mode.
Payable constructor that sets msg.sender as the initial admin; no arguments required.
Modifier that executes the body only when msg.sender equals _admin(), otherwise routes the call to _fallback().
Internal view helper returning the logic address stored in LOGIC_SLOT via inline assembly sload.
Internal view helper returning the proposal restriction block stored in PROPOSE_BLOCK_SLOT.
Internal view helper returning the earliest activation block stored in NEXT_LOGIC_BLOCK_SLOT.
Internal view helper returning the trust-minimized flag stored in TRUST_MINIMIZED_SLOT.
Internal view helper returning the admin address stored in ADMIN_SLOT.
Internal function writing a new admin address into ADMIN_SLOT with inline assembly sstore.
External ifAdmin function that transfers admin rights and emits AdminChanged.
External ifAdmin function that promotes NEXT_LOGIC_SLOT into LOGIC_SLOT once the delay block has passed.
Payable fallback function delegating all unknown calls to _fallback().
Payable receive function delegating plain value transfers to _fallback().
Internal fallback that forbids the admin from entering the delegatecall path and forwards execution to _delegate(_logic()).
External ifAdmin function that cancels a pending upgrade by copying LOGIC_SLOT into NEXT_LOGIC_SLOT.
External ifAdmin function that raises PROPOSE_BLOCK_SLOT and emits UpgradesRestrictedUntil.
External ifAdmin function that flips TRUST_MINIMIZED_SLOT to true, irreversibly enabling the delayed upgrade path.
Internal function writing block.number + 172800 into NEXT_LOGIC_BLOCK_SLOT.
Internal function that, after the proposal lock, stores a candidate logic address into NEXT_LOGIC_SLOT and emits NextLogicDefined.
Payable external ifAdmin function that either instantly installs newLogic when not trust-minimized, or schedules it, then delegatecalls newLogic with data.
Internal assembly routine copying calldata, delegatecalling the logic address, copying returndata and reverting or returning accordingly.
Caller-controlled address used for admin gating in the constructor, ifAdmin modifier and _fallback guard.
Inline assembly sstore writing the new admin address directly to ADMIN_SLOT, bypassing Solidity storage semantics.
Inline assembly block reading NEXT_LOGIC_SLOT and writing LOGIC_SLOT, swapping the implementation without checks beyond the block delay.
Inline assembly block reading LOGIC_SLOT and writing it into NEXT_LOGIC_SLOT.
Inline assembly sstore writing an attacker-supplied block number into PROPOSE_BLOCK_SLOT.
Inline assembly sstore writing true into TRUST_MINIMIZED_SLOT, locking the proxy into delayed-upgrade mode.
Inline assembly sstore writing the supplied newLogic address straight into LOGIC_SLOT when the proxy is not trust-minimized.
Inline assembly sstore writing block.number + 172800 into NEXT_LOGIC_BLOCK_SLOT, operating on raw storage slots.
Inline assembly sstore writing the candidate logic address into NEXT_LOGIC_SLOT.
delegatecall executed inside proposeToAndCall against an arbitrary newLogic address with user-supplied calldata, run in the proxy storage context.
Assembly delegatecall forwarding all gas and calldata to the stored logic contract in the proxy storage context.
Address parameter of changeAdmin used as the new admin.
Address parameter of _setAdmin written into ADMIN_SLOT.
Block number parameter of prolongLock that replaces PROPOSE_BLOCK_SLOT.
Candidate logic address parameter of _setNextLogic.
Logic contract address parameter of proposeToAndCall, used both as storage value and delegatecall target.
Calldata payload parameter of proposeToAndCall forwarded to the delegatecall.
Logic address parameter of _delegate used as the delegatecall target.
Local variable in upgrade holding the value loaded from NEXT_LOGIC_SLOT.
Local variable in cancelUpgrade holding the value loaded from LOGIC_SLOT.
Local variable in _updateBlockSlot computing block.number + 172800.
Local variable in proposeToAndCall capturing the delegatecall success flag.

edges.reason: Constructor forwards msg.sender to _setAdmin to fix the initial admin from untrusted caller input.
Constructor body calls _setAdmin(msg.sender).
ifAdmin compares the untrusted msg.sender against the stored admin to decide whether the admin body runs.
ifAdmin resolves the admin identity by calling _admin().
ifAdmin routes non-admin callers into _fallback() instead of the guarded body.
changeAdmin is gated by the ifAdmin modifier.
changeAdmin calls _setAdmin(newAdm) to persist the new admin.
changeAdmin passes its address parameter newAdm into _setAdmin.
upgrade is gated by the ifAdmin modifier.
upgrade requires block.number >= _nextLogicBlock() before promoting the pending logic.
upgrade loads the pending logic address into the local variable logic.
upgrade executes the inline assembly that reads NEXT_LOGIC_SLOT and writes LOGIC_SLOT.
cancelUpgrade is gated by the ifAdmin modifier.
cancelUpgrade captures the active logic address into its local variable.
cancelUpgrade executes the inline assembly that overwrites NEXT_LOGIC_SLOT with LOGIC_SLOT.
prolongLock is gated by the ifAdmin modifier.
prolongLock consumes the caller-supplied block parameter b.
prolongLock verifies b > _proposeBlock() before storing it.
prolongLock executes the inline assembly writing PROPOSE_BLOCK_SLOT.
removeTrust is gated by the ifAdmin modifier.
removeTrust executes the inline assembly writing true into TRUST_MINIMIZED_SLOT.
fallback forwards execution to _fallback().
receive forwards execution to _fallback().
_fallback requires msg.sender != _admin(), using untrusted caller input as the access condition.
_fallback reads the admin identity through _admin() for its guard.
_fallback resolves the implementation address through _logic().
_fallback hands control to _delegate which delegatecalls the logic contract, executing external code in the proxy storage context.
_delegate runs the assembly delegatecall that forwards all gas to the logic contract.
_delegate uses parameter logic_ as the delegatecall target address.
proposeToAndCall is gated by the ifAdmin modifier.
proposeToAndCall branches on _logic() == address(0).
proposeToAndCall branches on the _trustMinimized() flag.
proposeToAndCall calls _updateBlockSlot() on the instant-upgrade branch.
proposeToAndCall calls _setNextLogic(newLogic) on the trust-minimized branch.
proposeToAndCall runs the inline assembly that writes LOGIC_SLOT directly.
proposeToAndCall delegatecalls arbitrary newLogic with caller-supplied data, allowing external code to run in the proxy context.
proposeToAndCall uses parameter newLogic both as stored value and delegatecall target.
proposeToAndCall forwards calldata parameter data into the delegatecall.
proposeToAndCall stores the delegatecall result in local variable success.
_setNextLogic requires block.number >= _proposeBlock().
_setNextLogic calls _updateBlockSlot() before storing the candidate.
_setNextLogic runs the inline assembly writing NEXT_LOGIC_SLOT.
_setNextLogic writes parameter nl into NEXT_LOGIC_SLOT.
_updateBlockSlot computes the local variable nlb = block.number + 172800.
_updateBlockSlot runs the inline assembly writing NEXT_LOGIC_BLOCK_SLOT.
_setAdmin executes inline assembly sstore into ADMIN_SLOT.
_setAdmin writes parameter newAdm into storage.
_logic sloads LOGIC_SLOT from raw storage.
_proposeBlock sloads PROPOSE_BLOCK_SLOT from raw storage.
_nextLogicBlock sloads NEXT_LOGIC_BLOCK_SLOT from raw storage.
_trustMinimized sloads TRUST_MINIMIZED_SLOT from raw storage.
_admin sloads ADMIN_SLOT to return the privileged address.
Assembly sstore writes the new admin directly into ADMIN_SLOT, controlling the privilege state variable.
Assembly sstore writes the pending logic into LOGIC_SLOT.
Assembly sload reads the pending logic from NEXT_LOGIC_SLOT before promotion.
cancelUpgrade assembly reads LOGIC_SLOT.
cancelUpgrade assembly writes the current logic into NEXT_LOGIC_SLOT.
Assembly sstore writes the caller-supplied block into PROPOSE_BLOCK_SLOT.
Assembly sstore writes true into TRUST_MINIMIZED_SLOT.
Assembly sstore writes newLogic into LOGIC_SLOT on the instant-upgrade branch.
Assembly sstore writes block.number + 172800 into NEXT_LOGIC_BLOCK_SLOT.
Assembly sstore writes the candidate logic address into NEXT_LOGIC_SLOT.
The delegatecall in proposeToAndCall targets the attacker-influenced newLogic address.
The delegatecall in proposeToAndCall forwards the caller-supplied data payload.
The assembly delegatecall in _delegate targets the logic_ parameter, executing arbitrary external code in proxy context.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter only carries the new admin address into the changeAdmin body and has no standalone semantics outside that function.
Parameter is a transient input of the internal _setAdmin helper that immediately writes it into ADMIN_SLOT.
Parameter b is only used inside prolongLock to raise the proposal lock via the PROPOSE_BLOCK_SLOT sstore.
Parameter nl is only consumed inside _setNextLogic and immediately stored into NEXT_LOGIC_SLOT.
Parameter newLogic is used solely within proposeToAndCall as storage value and delegatecall target.
Calldata parameter data exists only to feed the delegatecall performed inside proposeToAndCall.
Parameter logic_ is only meaningful as the delegatecall target inside the _delegate assembly routine.
Local variable logic is a temporary holder inside upgrade for the value promoted from NEXT_LOGIC_SLOT to LOGIC_SLOT.
Local variable logic is a temporary holder inside cancelUpgrade for the LOGIC_SLOT copy written into NEXT_LOGIC_SLOT.
Local variable nlb only exists to compute the value written into NEXT_LOGIC_BLOCK_SLOT inside _updateBlockSlot.
Local variable success only captures the delegatecall result checked by the require inside proposeToAndCall.
